questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Rajiv requested his friend to remove his shoes before entering his house.

options.text: Rajiv said to his friend, “Please remove your shoes before entering my house.”
Rajiv said to his friend, “Please remove his shoes before entering your house.”
Rajiv said to his friend, “You must remove his shoes before entering his house.”
Rajiv said to his friend, “Remove his shoes before entering my house.”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Rajiv said to his friend, “Please remove your shoes before entering my house.” "**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from indirect to direct speech.
 
• In the given sentence. the reporting verb "**requested**" in indirect speech will change to "**said to**" as the narration changes from third person to first person.
 
• In direct speech, we don't use reporting verbs which reflect the tone of the statement instead we use **interjections **to express an emotion.
 
• In the given statement, we use the interjection "**please**" to express the request to remove the shoes.
 
• The** third person** pronoun "**his**" in indirect speech will change to the **second person** pronoun "**your**" in direct speech as per the object of the reporting verb.
 
• The** third person** pronoun "**his**" in indirect speech will change to the **first person** pronoun "**my**" in direct speech. 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
